{"products":[{"id":10285366247672,"title":"Normcore 58mm Adjustable-Flow Tea Extraction Basket","handle":"normcore-58mm-adjustable-flow-tea-extraction-basket","body_html":"

Pressure extraction makes tea faster. Adjustable flow makes it more controllable.

The Normcore 58mm Adjustable-Flow Tea Extraction Basket combines the pressure of an espresso machine with a built-in flow-control system, giving you an additional way to manage tea extraction directly from the basket.

Unlike fixed-flow tea extraction systems, Normcore allows you to adjust how quickly water passes through the tea. This provides greater control over contact time, extraction strength, beverage volume, and concentration.

From delicate teas to concentrated milk-tea bases, one basket gives you the flexibility to develop different recipes using the espresso machine and compatible 58mm portafilter you already own.

WHY FLOW CONTROL MATTERS

Different teas do not extract in the same way.

Leaf size, tea type, dose, water temperature, and brewing time can all affect the final cup. A fixed-flow basket limits how much control you have over these variables.

The Normcore adjustable-flow system adds another level of control, allowing you to refine the extraction for different te
